title: Case studies: apps, websites and online stores by Agencia IDP
seo.title: Case Studies: Web, App and E-commerce Projects | Agencia IDP
seo.description: See web apps, mobile apps, WordPress sites and Shopify stores built by Agencia IDP for companies in Colombia, the US, Mexico and Latin America. Visit each project live.
sections[0].blocks[1].title: Colombia Memories
sections[0].blocks[1].html: Colombia Memories is a digital platform that connects people with Colombia’s cultural, historical and tourism heritage through an interactive web experience.
sections[0].blocks[2].title: Beanster
sections[0].blocks[2].html: Beanster is a mobile app for coffee lovers, offering a digital experience focused on discovering, exploring and enjoying the world of coffee.
sections[0].blocks[3].title: Tu Columna Habla
sections[0].blocks[3].html: Tu Columna Habla is a web platform for spine health education, guidance and follow-up, with accessible information and digital tools that promote good posture.
sections[0].blocks[4].title: Zona Pet
sections[0].blocks[4].html: Zona Pet is a mobile app that brings together everything related to pet care in one digital tool that users can access from their phones.
sections[0].blocks[5].title: Posrank
sections[0].blocks[5].html: Posrank is the platform to grow and measure your product’s visibility in search engines, AI engines and the 25 review channels that drive purchase decisions, backed by a real community.
sections[0].blocks[6].title: Capihost
sections[0].blocks[6].html: We built a platform for selling domains, servers and email hosting that works worldwide, with servers located in the US and India.
sections[0].blocks[7].title: Push Leads
sections[0].blocks[7].html: Push Leads is a CRM built to streamline customer management, automate follow-ups and improve sales conversion.
sections[0].blocks[8].title: SEDEFY
sections[0].blocks[8].html: SEDEFY is an academic management system that simplifies grade tracking, grading and school organization, letting schools manage attendance, student records and grades in one place.
sections[1].blocks[1].title: Bon Studio
sections[1].blocks[1].html: Bon Studio designs sensitive architecture that adapts to the way people live, creating functional, beautiful and harmonious spaces.
sections[1].blocks[2].title: Topa House
sections[1].blocks[2].html: Topa House is a modern informational website that showcases stylish, functional rooms, offering inspiration and details about each space with a focus on design trends.
sections[1].blocks[3].title: The Studio Miami
sections[1].blocks[3].html: The Studio Miami is a multidisciplinary interior design studio specializing in high-end residential and commercial projects, delivering practical architecture and design solutions that reflect each client’s vision and strengthen their brand.
sections[1].blocks[4].title: Maria Pilera
sections[1].blocks[4].html: María Pilera is an online store offering carefully selected, exceptionally crafted products to ensure customer satisfaction with every purchase.
sections[1].blocks[5].title: Ossalud
sections[1].blocks[5].html: Ossalud is an online store for medical and surgical supplies, with a broad catalog of high-quality products, secure payments, fast shipping and efficient customer service in a design built for easy, reliable shopping.
sections[1].blocks[6].title: Religare
sections[1].blocks[6].html: Religare is a luxury clothing store offering an exclusive shopping experience with a curated catalog, secure payments, premium shipping and personal service, in an elegant design optimized for every device.
sections[1].blocks[7].title: Dr Joaquí
sections[1].blocks[7].html: Dr. Joaquí is a physician specializing in IV therapy and regenerative medicine, with an informational website about his treatments, benefits and personalized approaches to patient health and wellness.
sections[1].blocks[8].title: Sebastián Uribe
sections[1].blocks[8].html: Sebastián Uribe is an online ceramics store with unique, handmade pieces focused on quality and craftsmanship, ideal for adding a personal, sophisticated touch to any space.
sections[1].blocks[9].title: Factum Digital
sections[1].blocks[9].html: Factum Digital is a digital marketing agency whose website presents its services, tailored strategies and case studies, helping brands improve their online presence and reach their business goals.
sections[1].blocks[10].title: Andrés Vallejo Balen
sections[1].blocks[10].html: Andrés Vallejo Balén is a surgeon whose website offers clear, reliable information about surgical procedures, pre- and post-operative recommendations and professional guidance for patients.
sections[2].blocks[1].title: Solua for People USA
sections[2].blocks[1].html: Solua for People is an online clothing store with easy navigation, secure payments, discounts, order management and customer service, in a design built for mobile and desktop.
sections[2].blocks[2].title: Dodo Nature
sections[2].blocks[2].html: Dodo Nature is a Shopify store selling clothing made from natural materials, committed to well-being and sustainability.
sections[2].blocks[3].title: Fajas Sens
sections[2].blocks[3].html: Fajas Sens is an online shapewear store with quality products, Klaviyo integration for personalized customer management, fast shipping, secure payments and efficient service, all easy to browse on any device.
sections[2].blocks[4].title: Fajas Tributo MX
sections[2].blocks[4].html: Fajas Tributo MX is an online shapewear store with an easy-to-browse catalog, secure payments, discounts and customer service, optimized for mobile and desktop.
sections[2].blocks[5].title: Trascendenza USA
sections[2].blocks[5].html: Trascendenza is a Shopify store selling meaningful jewelry that combines elegant design and symbolism to create unique pieces representing special moments and personal values.
sections[2].blocks[6].title: Amorfa Gemz
sections[2].blocks[6].html: Amorfa Gemz is an online jewelry store with an exclusive selection of elegant pieces, secure payments, fast shipping and personal service, in a sophisticated design adapted to every device.
